checks.label: not up two days in a row

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before

checks.label: consolidation quality

checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 5.3% vs its 20-SMA, 16.2% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The chart shows INSP on its fourth breakout attempt of a 60-session, 76% move — the Y check is a hard FAIL with three prior breakouts already recorded, and the notes confirm only 1 of 4 prior breakouts closed higher three sessions later. The RE check also fails because the burst bar is not the widest of the last five sessions, meaning the expansion is not convincing relative to recent activity. These two independent measured defects together pull the setup below A quality.
claude.key_risk: A fourth breakout from a mature, extended move with a poor prior-breakout success rate (1/4) sharply limits the probability of follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal-day high near 78.80 or if the stock opens below the burst-day close of 73.18 with no immediate buying interest in the first 30 minutes.
